mainEntity.name: Are there multi-story ADU floor plans available, and what are their advantages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, multi-story ADU floor plans are available and can be an excellent option for properties with limited ground space or specific view requirements. Their primary advantage is maximizing living area on a smaller footprint, preserving more yard space. They can also offer better views from upper levels and provide a clear separation between living and sleeping areas. However, multi-story ADUs may require more complex engineering and construction, potentially impacting cost and build time compared to single-story designs. Local zoning rules will dictate if a multi-story ADU is permissible.
